Class SinglePlayGameController

java.lang.Object
app.controller.SinglePlayGameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardObserver, ChatObserver, DeckObserver, LogObserver
public class SinglePlayGameController extends Object implements CardObserver, DeckObserver, LogObserver, ChatObserver
The SinglePlayGameController class handles the main logic and state of a single-player game. It manages the game flow, UI interactions, and game state updates for a turn-based card game.

    • startGame

      public void startGame()
      Initializes and starts the game.

      This method sets up the game environment, including drawing the game page, generating the deck, and creating players. It manages the sequential animations for dealing cards and placing the starting dummy card. Once the setup is complete, it begins the main game loop and enables user interaction.

      Key functionalities: - Draws the main game page on the interface. - Generates the deck and initializes player roles. - Logs the game setup process in the specified system language. - Executes a sequence of animations for dealing cards and placing a starting card. - Initiates the core game logic and enables gameplay actions.

    • update

      public void update(Card card)
      Updates the game state based on the card being played. It logs the action, evaluates specific card ranks to invoke corresponding behaviors, passes the turn if none of the specified conditions are met, and clears all current deck and card effects.
      Specified by:
      update in interface CardObserver
      Parameters:
      card - The Card instance that is played, containing its suit and rank information.

    • updateAddToDeck

      public void updateAddToDeck(Card card)

      Specified by:

      Parameters:
      card - The Card instance to be added to the deck. This card will be included in the deck's card collection and the deck will be reshuffled.

    • resetGame

      public void resetGame(List<Player> prevPlayers)
      Resets the game state and initializes a new game session. This method performs the following operations: 1. Initializes and draws the game page. 2. Resets the deck and transforms the list of players. 3. Sets up a sequence of animations and transitions. 4. Starts the game loop and enables game interactions.
      Parameters:
      prevPlayers - The list of players from the previous game session, sorted in descending order and transformed for the new game.

    • setTurnEffect

      public void setTurnEffect()
      Updates the visual effect of the timer based on the current player's turn. If the current turn belongs to the local player, the timer effect is activated. Otherwise, the timer effect is deactivated.
